status: target semantic bindings; not a registry of currently callable CLI commands or HTTP URLs
envelope: World protocol section 2; authentication is transport-derived, not caller-granted

profiles.transaction: snapshot plus atomic conditional durable commit/outbox
profiles.reactive: transaction plus resumable feed and snapshot handoff
profiles.workflow: transaction plus durable run checkpoints and fenced ownership

rules: Operation IDs name semantics, not transport paths.
The backend adapter maps each operation to its actual selected implementation; it cannot combine independent lane guarantees by assertion.
A pure compute.submit rejects an effectful DAG; effectful graphs require command.submit and per-operation admission.
Local metadata persistence, remote storage, and subprocesses add their actual registered capabilities; effect labels cannot suppress these checks.
history.restore must not be implemented as an unguarded call to the existing live-graph replay route.
Read/evaluate never implies shared mutation or external effects.
response_record is a central evidence record where applicable, not the complete wire envelope. Request fields are semantic inventory, not executable parameter schemas.
Live browse_scope and pinned context selectors are mutually exclusive; pure evaluation requires the latter.
Replayable workflow steps prohibit immediate tool/transport effects; all fresh observations and effects require stable named step/action identity.
